findingDetails.title: Dead exported fallback-gate helper has no caller
findingDetails.evidence: Repo-wide symbol search over .skilled/.opencode/.pi (source and compiled output) finds only the definition and its runtime/dist twin; no import in the Claude hook, Pi hook, brief builder, plugin, or tests.

findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -rn over .skilled/.opencode/.pi for the exported symbol; compared against all import sites of the fallback module

findingDetails.title: Operator budget above the shim kill ceiling is silently ineffective
findingDetails.evidence: The shim overrides SPECKIT_CLAUDE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS only when unset, then kills the advisor child at CHILD_TIMEOUT_MS=2500 regardless; the advisor applies the operator value as its CLI budget via positiveIntFromEnv, so a value above 2500 is killed before it can emit the directives fallback and the turn returns {}.
findingDetails.recommendation: Clamp the pass-through to CHILD_TIMEOUT_MS minus margin, or document the 2500 ms ceiling beside the variable.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the shim spawn/limit block, advisor claudeHookTimeoutMs plumbing, and the fallback timer; nested deadline chain 2800/2500/2200 verified by hand

noveltyJustification: First pass over this surface; two P2 advisories, no P0/P1. Nested deadline ordering, stale-daemon retry condition and daemon error mapping, casual-prompt gate reconnect, runtime label propagation, Pi dual import paths, and both handler enrichment sites were verified end-to-end.

findingDetails.title: Runtime vocabulary drift - three hardcoded enum copies reject the four runtimes phase 002 added
findingDetails.evidence: advisor-runtime-values.ts declares the tuple the single source of truth, and the record validators accept all seven runtimes via enumIncludes(ADVISOR_RUNTIME_VALUES), but outcomeEvents[].runtime remains ['claude','copilot','opencode'] in the daemon zod schema, the advisor_validate tool descriptor (runtime/tools/advisor-validate.ts:22) and the CLI manifest (runtime/skill-advisor-cli-manifest.ts:89). A pi/codex/cursor/devin outcome event is rejected by both the daemon (-32602) and the CLI, while the persist-side type would accept it. Phase 002 plan.md named seven readers and none of these three.
findingDetails.recommendation: Derive all three enums from ADVISOR_RUNTIME_VALUES or document the intentional narrowing in the schema.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Grepped the runtime and hooks trees for the three-value literal, found exactly three source copies plus their dist twins; compared against the accept-side validators in metrics.ts

findingDetails.title: Diagnostics log created with default permissions under os.tmpdir()
findingDetails.evidence: DURABLE_METRICS_ROOT is join(tmpdir(),'speckit-skill-advisor-metrics'); ensureParentDir uses mkdir with no mode and the JSONL is written with appendFile/writeFile default modes subject only to umask, so a shared Linux host with umask 022 exposes a 0755 directory and 0644 files. Content is prompt-free by design but exposes skill labels, runtimes, timing and error detail; written only when SKILL_ADVISOR_DEBUG is on.
findingDetails.recommendation: Create the root 0o700 and files 0o600; note mkdir recursive does not repair a pre-existing directory, so chmod explicitly.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the metrics root constant, ensureParentDir, writeBoundedJsonl append/rename paths, and the prompt-free closed schema; no chmod anywhere in the module

noveltyJustification: Security pass over model-visible and trust-surfaces: renderer sanitization, plugin spawn argv construction, plugin/renderer fallback parity, workspace-root allowlist, schema strictness, and the phase 004/005 requirement claims were all verified clean. Two new P2s recorded: a runtime vocabulary drift and a temp-permission hardening gap.

findingDetails.title: Confirm-mode review workflow never consumes stop_policy so max-iterations can stop before the ceiling
findingDetails.evidence: Both review YAMLs document 'max-iterations treats convergence as telemetry until the hard iteration ceiling' at line 38, but only deep-review-auto.yaml implements it (:624 ':646'); confirm extracts stop_policy (:569) and stores it (:433,:447) while step_check_convergence promotes all-dimensions-clean (:627) and composite convergence to a STOP candidate with no max-iterations guard. Research relies on effective_min_iterations (auto :729, confirm :677), which review does not define. Alternative reading: confirm mode delegates the guard to the operator. Scope note: adjacent to the changed step_convergence_report hunk, not inside it.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the auto-mode telemetry clause to confirm, or document the confirm-mode difference at line 38.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Statement-level diff of step_check_convergence across the four YAMLs; grep for stop_policy, max-iterations, telemetry and effective_min_iterations in all four; ledger scope shapes cross-checked against deep-review-ledger-schema.vitest.ts
